name: LEGEND-200
full_name: Large Enriched Germanium Experiment for Neutrinoless double-beta Decay - LEGEND-200
summary: LEGEND-200 builds on GERDA and the Majorana Demonstrator to search for germanium-76 neutrinoless double-beta decay at Gran Sasso. This dossier covers the implemented 200-kg-class stage; LEGEND-1000 has its own future-project record.
detection_principle: Enriched germanium detectors operate in an instrumented liquid-argon bath. Germanium pulse shapes, coincidence cuts and scintillation vetoes suppress backgrounds while retaining a narrow decay-energy peak.

results.summary: LEGEND-200 published its first neutrinoless-decay search results; its 1000-kg successor remains a distinct planned stage.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
